notes: Modified cash basis school district. Governmental receipts/disbursements from the Total Governmental Funds column (p5); roll-forward uses fund balance 2,494,466 to 2,172,503 as cash. Transfers in 50,000 / out 105,000 are net of 125,000 elimination (Elimination column removes 125,000 from both Operation and Maintenance of Plant disbursements and transfers in; total column already net, so no extra split needed). Bond Proceeds 3,000,000 = debt_proceeds; Bond Issuance Costs (51,745) = other_financing. 'Other' local receipts 46,851 split using General Fund budget schedule (Public Power District Sales Tax 13,741 + Miscellaneous Local Receipts 33,110, p8). Printed report discrepancy: Property and Carline Taxes line is 1 higher than the fund columns (see report_discrepancies); receipt lines sum 5,171,909 vs printed total 5,171,908. Business-type = School Nutrition Fund (p7): operating receipts 20,916 + nonoperating USDA and State Subsidy 102,897; transfers in 55,000; 66,728 + 123,813 - 201,989 + 55,000 = 43,552. Balance sheet from government-wide Statement of Net Position (p1) total column; no liabilities. Detail: General Fund receipts from p8 budget schedule; General Fund disbursements from the more detailed Budgetary Schedule of Disbursements (p10-11), so function-level disbursement table on p9 (budget schedule) not repeated except transfers; zero-actual lines skipped. Activity fund recorded account by account from p18 (only Athletics and Academics subtotals present in the trimmed PDF; the remaining accounts are not in the trimmed pages) instead of the one-line p17 budget schedule; Athletics and Academics treated as separate fund groups with their printed subtotals.
